subject: Can ggfluctuation automatic detect labels from table?

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: Can ggfluctuation automatic detect labels from table?
parts:
Hi,


ggfluctuation label the axis as x and y. I could use xlab and ylab to
add the axis label manually according to the table dirnames. I think
that it may make more sense to label the axis according to the table's
dimnames. Could you let me know if ggfluctuation can figure out the
labels by itself?

###########

library(ggplot2)

m=3
n=5
adf=data.frame(
Y1=sample(m,100,replace=T)
, X1=sample(n,100,replace=T)
)

tb=table(adf)

ggfluctuation(tb)
#ggfluctuation(tb)+xlab('X1')+ylab('Y1')


--
Regards,
Peng
